title: BIS Project Aurum Phase 2 Tests Privacy-Preserving Digital Cash
why_it_matters: The prototype gives central banks a concrete architecture for testing whether digital cash can limit routine disclosure of payment data without removing compliance safeguards.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

BIS Project Aurum Phase 2 Tests Privacy-Preserving Digital Cash

A BIS Innovation Hub prototype combines cryptographic privacy tools with configurable compliance controls for digital cash; it is a research proof of concept, not a live payment system.
